title: Healer: The Dr. Joycelyn Elders Story
original_title: Healer: The Dr. Joycelyn Elders Story
overview: Healer: The Dr. Joycelyn Elders Story traces the remarkable life of Dr. Joycelyn Elders, who rose from humble beginnings in the cotton fields of Arkansas to national prominence as the first African American Surgeon General of the United States.
